name: Google News 中文: 北极 / 挪威

config.note: Topic-filtered Google News feed, not a whole outlet. There is no Chinese, Japanese or Hindi equivalent of Regard sur l'Arctique, and the alternative -- NHK's international section, BBC Chinese, Amar Ujala -- is 40-125 items per fetch of national news in which Norway appears a few times a week. A query feed inverts that: in-language coverage of this desk's subject, at a volume the beats can actually rank. Expect football and chess noise, since 'Norway' is a sports term in all three; the beat threshold discards it.
config.why: China calls itself a near-Arctic state, runs the Yellow River station at Ny-Alesund, promotes the Polar Silk Road, and is a major buyer of Norwegian seafood. Its Arctic shipping coverage is operational and detailed.
config.min_published_note: Loose recency floor, set 2026-09-28. A Google News query returns what best matches the query, not what is recent: 89 of 100 items from this feed's first fetch were over a month old and one was from 2024. 2025-01-01 rather than something tighter because background that is a year old is often still the right context for an Arctic policy story -- this is a guard against absorbing an archive in bulk, not a news window. The brief's own window is unchanged and much tighter.
